description.value: Copper is a CRM (customer relationship management) software company. Its product is built for relationship-focused service businesses and runs inside Google Workspace, including Gmail and Google Calendar.
Copper is a Google Workspace-focused CRM, founded in 2012 and based in San Francisco.

product_description.value: CRM software for contacts and leads, drag-and-drop deal pipelines, project management, email series and automation, reporting, a mobile app, and integrations with Google apps, Slack, QuickBooks, DocuSign, PandaDoc, Zapier, and an API.
CRM software for managing contacts, deals, leads, pipelines, and communications, integrated with Google Workspace.

business_model_description.value: Per-seat monthly subscriptions in three tiers: Basic $29/month ($23 billed annually), Professional $69/month ($59 billed annually), Business $134/month ($99 billed annually). 14-day free trial.
Subscription fees for its CRM platform and additional services.

customer_description.value: Agencies, consulting firms, commercial production companies, media and creator businesses, corporate development teams, financial services firms, and construction companies; also lists coaching and technology companies. Especially suited to small businesses and teams that already work in Google Workspace.
Agencies, consulting firms, commercial production companies, media and creators, corporate development teams, financial services, and the construction industry (per CB Insights).

headquarters.value: San Francisco, CA (address 301 Howard St, Suite 600, per ZoomInfo)
